W36

Course settings, syllabus and publication

/teach/courses/:courseId/settings
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S14

Define the learner-visible syllabus, course access window and AI-use ceiling with explicit publication history.

Entry and return
W35 settingsW15 staff preview return

HeaderTerm, course zone, draft/published syllabus versions
EditorAccessible syllabus sections, contacts, office-hours links and AI policy
ChecksPublication eligibility, changed rules and learner preview

States (4)
Incomplete syllabus
WhenRequired section blank
ShowsChecklist names missing sections
Way outComplete fields
Policy conflict
WhenAssessment AI rule exceeds ceiling
ShowsShow affected assessments and stricter effective rule
Way outReview W40/W41 before publication
Published revision pending
WhenStaff edits public text
ShowsSide-by-side changed paragraphs and effective dates
Way outPublish or discard draft
Uncertain save
WhenConnection fails during save
ShowsKeep draft; no success timestamp
Way outRetry after checking current version
Dialogs and drawers (1)
Publish changed syllabus
  • Old/new text, policy ceiling, effective timestamp and affected assessments
  • Published submission/attempt snapshots remain immutable
Return without applying changesPublish this revision
Permissions
  • Instructor alone changes course settings, publication and AI ceiling.
  • TA may read syllabus and preview within current course access; authoring proposal never changes policy. No allowance basis appears.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Learner preview displays exactly the published AI ceiling and syllabus version.
  • AI-disabled course never offers an assistant or drafting action.
  • Changing zone requires reviewing date effects; failure preserves the old published syllabus.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
